jobs.name: r6_native_source_tests
argv:
import json, pathlib, sys, pytest, torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
root=pathlib.Path("E:/ZMY/Github/TSFM-FAIS/artifacts/iclr27-r6/native-source-tests-v001")
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
result=pytest.main(['-q','tests/unit/test_native_source_transfer.py','--basetemp',str(root/'temp'),'--junitxml',str(root/'tests.xml')])
(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'completed' if result==0 else 'failed','pytest_exit_code':int(result)},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
sys.exit(result)
